    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]

    points.sort()
    # Continue the diagonal direction shared by the existing 1-cells.
    (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = points[-2], points[-1]
    dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
    if dr == 0 or dc == 0:
        return out
    dr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
    dc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
    r, c = r2 + dr, c2 + dc
    while 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]):
        out[r][c] = 1
        r += dr
        c += dc
    return out
